// diagnostic L0101

Jet.UnusedLocalBinding

Local binding `{name}` is never read.

What

Local binding `{name}` is never read.

Why

A binding that no later expression reads adds dead code and may hide a computed result that should have been used.

Fix

Remove the binding when its initializer is side-effect free, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when the value must be computed.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnusedLocalBinding: Tests/UILint/fact_read_is_a_use.warn.

Error: Jet.UnusedLocalBinding: Local binding `forgotten` is never read.
  --> Tests/UILint/fact_read_is_a_use.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     forgotten: Float{1.5}
    |     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A binding that no later expression reads adds dead code and may hide a computed result that should have been used.
 Fix: Remove the binding when its initializer is side-effect free, or rename `forgotten` to `_forgotten` when the value must be computed.
